rules.chapter_title: Native-first boundaries and minimality
rules.title: Thin export scope
rules.owner: plasticos_export
rules.normative_text: `plasticos_export` SHALL own only the missing export-specific booking/shipment context, applicability declarations, views and QWeb report layouts; it SHALL first inspect and reuse existing Odoo/PlasticOS records and SHALL NOT recreate storage, a logistics/dispatch engine, inventory, finance, or a shared document-compliance engine.

rules.chapter_title: Native-first boundaries and minimality
rules.title: Single authoritative fact owner
rules.owner: existing native and domain owners
rules.normative_text: Original bytes/versions belong to native Odoo Documents or approved `ir.attachment` fallback; business evidence classification/verification belong to `plasticos_documents`; purchase/sales and financial facts belong to native Odoo; stock movements belong to native Stock; freight, dispatch and approved external operational mail belong to `plasticos_logistics`/Linda. Export SHALL only bind and display those facts.

rules.chapter_title: Native-first boundaries and minimality
rules.title: Exact associations without mandatory early buyer
rules.owner: Export binding; native commercial owners
rules.normative_text: All export bookings, sale/purchase order lines, loads, documents, packages and containers SHALL be linked by exact company and typed identity, not guessed partner/name/newest record. A supplier-backed load or owned in-transit inventory MAY have no assigned buyer or sales order until a real sale occurs, subject to the approved procurement/movement authority. An actual customer sale SHALL retain its real buyer. No artificial buyer, sales order, transaction or stock picking SHALL be created merely to satisfy a foreign-key or dispatch constraint.

rules.chapter_title: Native-first boundaries and minimality
rules.title: Evidence proposals are not unauthorized business transitions
rules.owner: native state owner; authorized tool command
rules.normative_text: Saving or extracting a booking, receiving a file, scanning, or generating a report SHALL NOT directly set a purchase, sale, transaction, stock, load, compliance, financial or regulatory state. A verified source observation MAY request a *named, authorized* state-owner business action if exact scope, preconditions, idempotency, and actor permissions are satisfied. The authoritative owner SHALL enforce the transition and return accepted/refused with reason and provenance; no direct state write or bypass is allowed.

rules.chapter_title: Native-first boundaries and minimality
rules.title: Capability proof and deployment independence
rules.owner: Odoo deployment/license owner
rules.normative_text: Before depending on Enterprise Documents, Inventory Barcode, AI/OCR or IoT device features, installation, licensing and actual installed API SHALL be verified; where the approved build lacks a capability, Export SHALL use an explicitly approved native fallback or keep it unavailable rather than fabricate or silently require it.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: Booking-to-order and shipment cardinality independent
rules.owner: plasticos_export booking association; native commercial and Logistics identities
rules.normative_text: A booking SHALL have an authoritative typed company and revision context and MAY relate to one or more physical containers/movements according to the real carrier reservation. One Sales Order or Purchase Order MAY be fulfilled by many loads and distinct bookings; a physical shipment SHALL be linked to its applicable booking and exact order-line/fulfillment allocation without requiring the entire SO or PO to be one shipment. The booking, drayage load, ISO container, seal, stock package/lot and order remain separate identities. A new booking model is conditional on reuse evidence.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: Six first-class booking values
rules.owner: plasticos_export for gaps only
rules.normative_text: Booking No., Steamship Line, Port of Loading, Port of Discharge, Cut Off and Earliest Return Date SHALL be first-class searchable/displayable booking information when supplied; existing authoritative fields SHALL be reused before creating storage. Booking No. remains an unmodified string; Steamship Line SHALL be distinct from forwarder and drayage carrier; POL/POD SHALL be distinct from terminal, rail ramp and final destination.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: ERD and cargo cutoff semantics
rules.owner: plasticos_export schedule context
rules.normative_text: Earliest Return Date SHALL represent the effective earliest permitted loaded-container receiving/gate-in window for the stated booking and facility; Cut Off SHALL represent its stated cargo/terminal acceptance deadline. ERD, cargo cutoff, shipping-instruction cutoff, VGM cutoff, documentation, rail and filing deadlines SHALL remain distinct. A booking without a supplied timestamp SHALL remain date-only or unknown, without invented time-of-day.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: Schedule source, revisions and time zones
rules.owner: plasticos_export schedule context + native document provenance
rules.normative_text: Each booking schedule assertion SHALL retain exact source/original reference, reporter, observed time, terminal/local time zone, value precision, effective revision and supersession. A later email SHALL NOT silently overwrite a confirmed cutoff/ERD, and conflicting carrier/terminal notices SHALL remain visible until the responsible party resolves them.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: Operational readiness is a projection
rules.owner: plasticos_export view/exception projection
rules.normative_text: Export schedule and readiness views SHALL derive status from current booking evidence, native load/stock status and verified document applicability without becoming a second source of physical or regulatory state. A schedule conflict, missing applicable proof or expired acceptance window SHALL produce an attributed exception; an observed gate event is not automatically legal delivery/risk transfer.

rules.chapter_title: Booking identity, six fields and schedule evidence
rules.title: Commercial label is not a legal Incoterm
rules.owner: native Odoo order/contract + export display
rules.normative_text: The recycler trade labels `FOB` (buyer pickup), `FAS` (seller-included freight to agreed port/rail), and `CNF`/`C&F` SHALL be preserved as quoted business usage separately from any explicitly contracted formal ICC Incoterm and named place. Booking arranger, payer, contracted handoff and exporter/filing role SHALL be explicit facts, not inferred from either shorthand. Export SHALL never silently rewrite an order Incoterm.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Native intake, AI-proposed extraction and exact document attribution
rules.owner: native Documents intake; plasticos_documents exact evidence link
rules.normative_text: Booking confirmations, amendments, gate receipts, emails and other originals SHALL enter through native Documents/approved attachments and retain original bytes, versions and attributable metadata. Odoo 19 AI document facilities MAY extract proposed typed booking values and candidate relations, but SHALL NOT auto-commit a partner-only or newest-open-record guess. The document owner SHALL resolve the exact company, booking, intended physical shipment and valid revision (or hold for review) before Export consumes facts; no duplicate original store or verifier.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Applicability belongs to export, verdict to Documents
rules.owner: export applicability / `plasticos_documents` verification
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL declare which document categories are required for the specific booking, phase, agreement, party, stage and requested operation. `plasticos_documents` SHALL own whether exact current evidence meets those requirements and whether an authorized override applies. Export SHALL consume that verdict, never author its own verified/compliant status or second rule evaluator.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: No duplicate verification action
rules.owner: `plasticos_documents`
rules.normative_text: Native Documents UI/actions SHALL delegate business verification, refusal and override to one approved `plasticos_documents` owner with attributable actor, source/version and scope; Export SHALL be read-only for the verification result. Existing duplicated native `verified` actions SHALL be reconciled at the Documents owner before Export relies on their output.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Native export-specific reports
rules.owner: plasticos_export QWeb layout / native source values
rules.normative_text: Export MAY own only export-specific QWeb report templates and view composition (booking/dispatch sheet, container/package packing list, exceptions, outbound document packet). Data SHALL come from the current native sales, stock, logistics, booking and verified Documents owners; reports SHALL be version-aware, audience-safe and shall not impersonate a third-party issued B/L or certification.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Linda owns external sends
rules.owner: `plasticos_logistics` / Linda using native Odoo Mail
rules.normative_text: An export screen MAY request an authorized outgoing report, booking reply, document request or amendment through the approved existing Linda/Odoo Mail operation. Export SHALL NOT send, retry, chase, or separately schedule the same external correspondence; queued, sent and unknown delivery outcomes SHALL remain distinct and attributable.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Missing documents use existing activity owners
rules.owner: `plasticos_documents`/native Activity; Linda external reminders
rules.normative_text: A missing or invalid export-required file SHALL appear as one scoped Documents compliance exception and the appropriate native internal Activity/Request; any approved external chase uses the existing Linda obligation and native scheduler. Export SHALL NOT add a recurring document-chase cron or another reminder ledger.

rules.chapter_title: Document applicability, evidence and reporting
rules.title: Correct document type and actual obligation
rules.owner: export applicability / document type owner
rules.normative_text: The required file set SHALL depend on actual booking, cargo, contract, destination/transit jurisdiction and responsible party; Phase 1 shall not require every Phase 2 ocean document. Domestic truck BOL, carrier-issued ocean B/L, verified gross mass evidence, commercial invoice and filings SHALL be separately classified and attributed; a file received is not a valid approval merely by existing.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 1: recycler FOB pickup and FAS port/rail
rules.title: FOB buyer pickup as industry operation
rules.owner: commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.normative_text: Phase 1 SHALL support `FOB pickup` in the operator’s recycling trade meaning: buyer/agent arranges pickup at the agreed origin. Export MAY display linked booking evidence when supplied but SHALL NOT require ocean booking data or seller-arranged freight for every FOB pickup. Pickup, carrier and physical dispatch remain existing logistics/stock operations.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 1: recycler FOB pickup and FAS port/rail
rules.title: FAS inland freight-included delivery
rules.owner: commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.normative_text: Phase 1 SHALL support `FAS delivered port/rail` in the operator’s established recycling trade meaning: seller includes the agreed inland transportation to the identified port/rail destination. It SHALL expose booking details and timing when relevant, reusing existing carrier/freight/load authority; it SHALL NOT infer seller ocean freight or substitute the formal ICC FAS risk-transfer point.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 1: recycler FOB pickup and FAS port/rail
rules.title: Physical handoff and commercial allocation are independent
rules.owner: Logistics and native Stock; Documents verification; Export projection
rules.normative_text: Each Phase 1 movement SHALL preserve actual pickup, gate/rail acceptance, named handoff place and source evidence independently of whether a buyer is already allocated. An owned supplier-backed movement with no assigned buyer is an eligible commercial scenario only when its separate authorization and destination/booking requirements are satisfied. Sale order fulfillment or invoicing may occur later under its own native authority; terminal arrival, gate acceptance and legal transfer are distinct.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 1: recycler FOB pickup and FAS port/rail
rules.title: ERD-to-cutoff dispatch visibility
rules.owner: export schedule view + Linda
rules.normative_text: Where a live booking or terminal appointment exists, Phase 1 SHALL present its current sourced ERD/cargo cutoff window and risk exception to the responsible coordinator. Changes SHALL not independently modify a Linda commitment, dispatch, or send an amendment; these are coordinated through the existing owner.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 1: recycler FOB pickup and FAS port/rail
rules.title: Native documents and simple views first
rules.owner: `plasticos_export` views/report layout
rules.normative_text: The Phase 1 export UI SHALL prioritize a booking/shipment list/form, ERD and cargo cutoff visibility, missing-evidence exceptions, a linked document view and a small set of native export reports. A dedicated new export workflow engine or complex overseas tracking UI is out of scope.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: In-transit sale reuses original shipment and evidence
rules.owner: native commercial sale and inventory owner; Export link/projection
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 SHALL support a genuine buyer purchasing material already on the water, including later sale-order allocation to existing identified cargo while preserving original purchase, container, booking, stock custody, delivery, and documents. The seller/buyer, title terms, Incoterm, approval and pricing SHALL be governed by the real native commercial owner and contract. No new parallel shipment/stock ledger or retroactive falsification of historic transport facts is permitted.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: Freight-inclusive price/role semantics
rules.owner: native commercial order + `plasticos_logistics`
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 SHALL support recycler `CNF/C&F` trade shorthand, and explicit contractual CFR/CIF terms where agreed, while preserving booking arranger, freight payer, ocean carrier/forwarder, insurer when applicable, seller obligations and agreed destination separately. Freight quotes/actuals remain with existing logistics/accounting owners; terms SHALL NOT alone infer title transfer or risk at destination.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: Ocean milestones are sourced facts
rules.owner: `plasticos_export` contextual projection / third-party evidence
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 MAY expose verified vessel/voyage, container loading, port departure, discharge, delivery and exception information where carrier/forwarder data is actually supplied; each observation SHALL retain source and revision, and SHALL NOT overwrite native stock, freight or customer delivery authority.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: Ocean B/L, shipping instructions and VGM
rules.owner: native Documents + document compliance + export applicability
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 SHALL coordinate applicable shipping instructions, issued ocean B/L (carrier/forwarder original), required VGM evidence and export packet documents using native original custody and shared verification. Export SHALL NOT forge or issue a carrier B/L, assert VGM compliance from package-net sum alone, or add a separate document verifier.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: Applicable regulated filings and filing actors
rules.owner: external filing authority + native Documents evidence
rules.normative_text: Where material, destination, transit, and law require export filings, permits, consents or jurisdiction-specific documents, Phase 2 SHALL record the applicable decision, responsible exporter/filer, authority and evidence/status with explicit attribution. It SHALL NOT auto-approve material legality, submit AES/customs filings or claim a compliance clearance without authorized integration and verified real result.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2: international sale and ocean obligations
rules.title: Phase 2 operations remain native-first
rules.owner: native Odoo + Linda + Documents
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL reuse native multi-currency orders, accounting, payments, stock, existing freight/dispatch and document operations for international selling; destination-milestone and report requirements SHALL not cause duplicate finance, carrier mail, scheduler, stock or new payment state machine.

rules.chapter_title: Security, exceptions, readiness and acceptance
rules.title: Audience/confidentiality and company isolation
rules.owner: native Odoo ACLs + Documents/Linda owners
rules.normative_text: Every booking, document link, generated report, outgoing recipient and related stock/order lookup SHALL enforce the exact company and approved audience. Supplier economics, buyer identity, freight economics and sensitive documents SHALL NOT leak across a brokered trade or company boundary; Export SHALL not grant external Documents access.

rules.chapter_title: Security, exceptions, readiness and acceptance
rules.title: Unknown and contradictory evidence remains visible
rules.owner: export projections with source owner decisions
rules.normative_text: Missing, wrong-party, stale, superseded, conflicted or uncertain export evidence SHALL remain UNKNOWN/pending with an attributed exception. Export SHALL NOT use fuzzy linking, optimistic defaults or AI/OCR inferences to declare a validated booking, shipment, compliant document, gate acceptance or regulatory result.

rules.chapter_title: Security, exceptions, readiness and acceptance
rules.title: Order, shipment, evidence and transaction states remain scoped
rules.owner: native commercial/state owners; Export read-only projection
rules.normative_text: Purchase/Sale ordered quantity, each physical receipt/dispatch, each booking/terminal milestone, document verification, transaction state, invoicing and financial settlement SHALL remain independent and scoped to the correct child/line. One of four weekly loads delivered SHALL NOT mark the entire four-load PO fulfilled nor a 30-load SO delivered. AI may propose a transition but the existing validated state owner SHALL apply it only if the explicitly required evidence, quantities and authorization permit it.

rules.chapter_title: Security, exceptions, readiness and acceptance
rules.title: Minimality and acceptance gate
rules.owner: product owner/repository implementation owner
rules.normative_text: A future proposed export field, model, menu, QWeb report, cron or automation SHALL carry a source-owner census, a concrete unmet business action and one positive plus one failure acceptance case. Rules are planning requirements until separately admitted and implemented. Each real test SHALL cite its BRS ID, exact repo revision and observed evidence; no unrun scenario may be labeled PASS.

rules.chapter_title: Security, exceptions, readiness and acceptance
rules.title: Safe change and activation boundaries
rules.owner: operator + live owner of each capability
rules.normative_text: The export BRS pack SHALL not itself install a module, activate mail or cron, create shipment transactions, approve legal filings or change Native-First BRS semantics. Any implementation/cutover requires a bounded separately authorized contract; changes to prior locked decisions require explicit dated supersession, preserving old rules and acceptance trace.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Equipment vocabulary differentiates road trailers from ocean containers
rules.owner: Logistics transport equipment classification; Export uses scoped choices
rules.normative_text: The transport equipment selections SHALL distinguish domestic road trailers from maritime freight containers. It SHALL NOT conflate vehicle/trailer identity, ISO container identity, shipping booking identity, Odoo stock package identity, or an internal load. A chassis carrying an ocean container remains a ground transport leg associated with a distinct maritime container.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Supported domestic trailer choices
rules.owner: Logistics transport equipment; Export references for terminal drayage if applicable
rules.normative_text: Domestic dispatch SHALL support 53-foot trailers, 48-foot trailers and flatbeds. Flatbeds SHALL be a type independent of any assumed universal length; dimensions and restrictions MAY be specified for the actual move. Export SHALL NOT create a second domestic trailer catalog or dispatch process.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Supported ocean container choices with a preference, not a hard constraint
rules.owner: Export booking presentation; shared logistics equipment semantics
rules.normative_text: Export booking choices SHALL include 40-foot high cube (40HC), 40-foot standard (40STD), 45-foot high cube (45HC), 45-foot standard (45STD) and 20-foot standard (20STD). For the operator's plastic exports, 40HC SHALL be the default suggested option, not an enforced selection. 20STD SHALL remain selectable for metal recyclers without precluding other cargo. Supported-in-UI does not assert steamship-line, route, port, or chassis availability.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Booking equipment count and per-week physical units
rules.owner: Export reservation; Logistics actual movements; native Stock cargo
rules.normative_text: A booking SHALL capture requested container equipment and count; physical units SHALL separately retain ISO number, seal, actual equipment, native stock packages and linked movement/load identity. Several containers MAY share one booking; distinct weekly movements MAY each have their own booking even when they share one PO and SO. Requested/actual equipment amendments SHALL not overwrite other siblings or invent copy-per-unit cargo weight.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Reuse only the correct equipment owner and native records
rules.owner: Logistics transport master/native shipping record; Export only booking-specific fields
rules.normative_text: Before adding any transport-type persistence, inspect native Odoo delivery/shipping and existing PlasticOS Logistics fields and extend the canonical owner only for an actual gap. `plasticos.equipment.type` is an existing FACILITY production/handling equipment registry (balers, granulators, etc.) and SHALL NOT be repurposed as a freight-container type registry. `plasticos_export` SHALL NOT create a competing universal equipment master, stock package, carrier record or transport engine.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Do not infer payload, capacity or VGM from nominal equipment name
rules.owner: Physical weight: native Odoo Stock and verified scale evidence; Export displays source facts
rules.normative_text: Equipment labels SHALL NOT imply a fixed cargo limit or certified legal weight. Actual scale observations, package net/tare, container tare, gross, lashing/packing weight where applicable, local carrier/road/port constraints, and any valid VGM evidence SHALL retain their respective sources, units, revisions and verification. Export SHALL NOT derive a certified VGM or commercial settlement quantity solely from scanned package weights or from a 40HC/20STD selection.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Equipment discrepancy and booking amendment are explicit
rules.owner: Export booking contextual exception; Documents evidence; Logistics physical movements
rules.normative_text: A mismatch between requested and supplied equipment SHALL be reported with provenance and require an authorized booking amendment or explicit exception resolution. Confirmed equipment type and actual container ID SHALL follow physical evidence. Export SHALL not rebook, dispatch, email the carrier, change stock, change the Incoterm or cancel a booking merely because an equipment selection changes.

rules.chapter_title: Transport equipment types, booking quantities and container identity
rules.title: Reports and loading must use exact units without duplicate inventory
rules.owner: Export views/QWeb; native Stock physical movement; Documents evidence/verification
rules.normative_text: Booking screens, loading/packing reports and associated documents SHALL display requested equipment, confirmed equipment, count and each actual container ID/seal as available, sourced from their owner. QR scans SHALL continue to update native Odoo stock/package movements and per-container loading evidence, not an export-owned inventory ledger. Blank/unconfirmed equipment or ambiguous load association SHALL display Unknown/Needs Review instead of inventing capacity, seal or departure status.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Buyer optional before a genuine sale
rules.owner: native Purchase/Stock + permitted Logistics movement authority
rules.normative_text: A purchase, real owned material, or authorized physical export movement MAY be recorded and progressed without a buyer, customer SO, or assigned end buyer when no sale exists. Supplier, company, approval, stock/custody, movement purpose, destination and applicable booking shall be real; buyer-dependent rules still apply to actual customer-sale release. No fake buyer/order or implied sale shall be used to bypass validation.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: One large customer commitment with smaller supply orders
rules.owner: native `sale.order`/`purchase.order` lines
rules.normative_text: One real buyer commitment (example: customer PO represented by one SO for 30 MRP loads) SHALL be fulfillable through multiple suppliers, supplier POs, and physical shipments. A supplier PO for 4 loads SHALL coexist with that 30-load SO without requiring four separate supplier POs; customer PO evidence is not a supplier PO.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Partial purchase fulfillment without PO duplication
rules.owner: native Odoo Purchase and Stock receipt/picking owner
rules.normative_text: A supplier PO MAY authorize multiple separately ready and executed loads across weeks. Native receipt/backorder and delivered/remaining quantity mechanics SHALL be used for each physically executed quantity; the PO obligation remains open for its unfulfilled balance. No Export-created parallel purchase/receipt counters.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Partial sales fulfillment and reserved allocation
rules.owner: native Odoo Sales and Stock delivery/move lines
rules.normative_text: A customer SO MAY be fulfilled by multiple suppliers and many loads; native reserved/delivered/unfulfilled quantities SHALL remain authoritative per order line and valid UoM. If a buyer is not yet assigned, cargo remains unallocated to a sale until real contract approval. A shipment association SHALL NOT alone validate its stock picking.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Independent booking per execution and container cardinality
rules.owner: Export booking and Logistics exact shipment links
rules.normative_text: One PO/SO may correspond to many bookings and loads; a single booking may cover multiple physical containers. A shipment SHALL identify its exact booking revision; no global one-to-one order-booking rule or single `transaction.load_id` may be used as the only association for a multi-load order. Define the smallest source-owned many-side association after a full cardinality census.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Fulfillment allocation is traceable without second quantity ledger
rules.owner: native Stock/Purchase/Sales actual lines; Export typed linkage
rules.normative_text: When a real order spans shipments or cargo is resold in transit, maintain exact links and quantities between the participating native PO/SO order lines, pickings/moves, shipment/load, container and applicable booking. No allocation may exceed authoritative available/contracted quantities; corrections, splits and reversals SHALL be attributed and must prevent double allocation.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Late buyer assignment and on-water resale
rules.owner: native commercial owner; stock custody; Export historic association
rules.normative_text: Buyer allocation MAY occur after pickup, terminal delivery or ocean sailing when a legal sale is entered and approved. The exact cargo/container/booking remains unchanged; the new sale association retains effective timestamps, actor, source contract, company and audit history. Change of physical destination or regulatory party requires independent logistics/filing authority and cannot be inferred from buyer allocation.

rules.chapter_title: Multi-order commitments, partial fulfillment, buyer-optional cargo and allocation
rules.title: Movement eligibility by purpose, not a universal buyer predicate
rules.owner: Logistics and native authorization owner, not Export
rules.normative_text: Movement release SHALL distinguish sale-backed delivery from approved procurement-owned/in-transit stock relocation or export drayage. Sales movements require a real buyer/SO when that workflow mandates it; lawful buyerless movements require approved company, supplier PO/owned stock authority, route/destination, cargo, applicable booking and permission. Logistics SHALL not rely on `sale_order_id` as the only possible company identity or on one transaction load field as the only exact movement link.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Use Odoo native AI Documents before custom extraction
rules.owner: native Odoo Documents AI, installed capability verified
rules.normative_text: When the approved Odoo 19 Enterprise AI Documents capability is available, incoming booking confirmations and amendments SHALL be classified and candidate booking data extracted through that native facility, not a parallel Export OCR/doc ingestion engine. Actual installed APIs, AI licensing/permissions, coverage and fallback SHALL be verified before activation; if unavailable, permit controlled manual booking entry.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Typed field extraction with source-level provenance
rules.owner: native AI candidate intake; export booking field owner
rules.normative_text: Native Odoo AI SHALL extract candidate values from both message body and attachments with explicit origin: purchase order reference, booking No., shipping line, POL/POD when present, ERD, terminal/cargo cutoff, equipment quantity/type, vessel/voyage, empty pickup and loaded return locations, dates, ticket, actual container/seal, reported weights and document requirements. Preserve exact strings including leading zeros, distinguishing time/date precision, reporter, field source and confidence. An absent field is UNKNOWN, never filled from a nearby attachment or assumption.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Exact company-and-booking match, never latest partner
rules.owner: PlasticOS Documents exact link and Export booking lookup
rules.normative_text: Before assigning an extracted fact, resolve company, source thread, exact PO/order and applicable booking revision, shipment/load and actual physical container/ticket via corroborated typed identifiers. Multiple bookings may reference one PO; booking identity alone does not identify a physical load before container/ticket linkage. Party-only, latest-open transaction and PDF filename matches are not sufficient. A conflict or unresolved one-to-many case enters a review/exception queue without incorrect downstream writes.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Ambiguity, conflicting originals and correction review
rules.owner: Documents verification owner; authorized export booking reviewer
rules.normative_text: When several candidate bookings, loads, companies, amended notices, or inconsistent ERD/cutoff fields are possible, AI SHALL abstain from authoritative writes and create a reviewable exception with candidate IDs and conflicting originals. A verified, authorized actor SHALL resolve exact linkage or reject it; the superseded/original evidence remains accessible.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Version-safe, idempotent apply
rules.owner: Export booking owner; native Documents original/version keeper
rules.normative_text: Native intake SHALL deduplicate identical original document bytes and email events while retaining distinct versions even when filenames repeat. AI SHALL classify a newly observed booking-related notice as initial confirmation, same-booking revision/roll, cancellation, replacement-booking cross-reference, or supplemental capacity only when evidence suffices; otherwise retain unresolved as a proposal. Prior originals and values remain queryable. A material booking change shall trigger only exact affected downstream reassessment, never automatic carrier rebooking, blanket load cancellation or commercial PO reissue.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Apply structured values only through approved owner interface
rules.owner: Export booking/record owner; Documents extraction producer
rules.normative_text: The AI component SHALL output an extraction proposal to a bounded write action that checks company, actor permission, field ownership, exact target, revision precondition and required evidence. Only fields owned by Export MAY be written there; original document classification/verification stays with Documents, transport facts with Logistics, contract values with Sales/Purchase, and stock with Inventory.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Transaction/load state changes only via validated commands
rules.owner: native state transition owner (Transaction/Logistics/Stock/Accounting)
rules.normative_text: Document-derived supplier readiness, loaded shipment confirmation, carrier acknowledgment, terminal/rail acceptance, vessel departure and booking cancellation SHALL be distinct typed event proposals tied to the exact shipment and source. After source verification, only the authorized Purchase/Stock/Logistics/Transaction business command may execute a permitted transition with its own prerequisites. A supplier statement "booking complete" is evidence of a supplier-reported milestone, not conclusive terminal gate-in, loaded-on-vessel or completed international delivery; parent PO/SO totals derive from verified partial execution.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo 19 AI booking extraction, exact association and guarded transitions
rules.title: Source-scoped status and human review observability
rules.owner: native Documents, Export exception presentation, Odoo Activities
rules.normative_text: Original received, extraction proposed, exact link pending, fields verified/applied, rejected, and downstream action accepted/refused SHALL be distinguishable source-backed statuses where needed using existing Odoo tracking and activity patterns. Document completeness SHALL be evaluated for the applicable shipment/milestone, not globally for an entire SO or four-load supplier PO.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Current booking requirements are revision-bound Logistics input
rules.owner: Export current booking view; Logistics decision/dispatch owner
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL provide the exact current ocean booking, source revision, terminal/rail destination, ERD, cutoff, equipment requested and related shipment identities as read-only/typed input to Logistics. An ocean carrier reservation SHALL not be treated as the truck/drayage company commitment; Logistics owns drayage selection, accepted rate, work order and dispatcher state.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Independent supplier PO issue and later booking delivery
rules.owner: native Purchase report + Export booking QWeb + Linda sending owner
rules.normative_text: A legitimate approved supplier PO SHALL be independently issuable through Linda's existing native-Purchase release without an ocean booking, buyer, load, or fictitious order. Supplier readiness and current booking confirmation MAY arrive later. Each current applicable booking original or clearly labeled booking summary SHALL be issued separately as its own revision-bound supplier communication when authorized. If both PO and booking are eligible simultaneously, a single message MAY carry two separately recognizable PDFs; they SHALL NOT be fused into a new document authority. Later weekly bookings under a still-open multi-load PO do not create, reapprove, or automatically reissue the commercial PO. A reference copy of unchanged PO is allowed only under explicit audience/revision-safe policy. Preserve distinct recipient, issue purpose, source revision, attempt and delivery evidence for PO issuance and booking issuance.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Carrier packet: booking and drayage Work Order, audience-safe
rules.owner: Logistics QWeb and authorized Linda sender; Export booking PDF source
rules.normative_text: Export drayage dispatch SHALL use a movement-specific current audience-safe booking PDF and a distinct drayage Work Order PDF plus only operation-required carrier instructions. The Work Order SHALL contain booking reference, equipment/chassis configuration, origin, terminal/ramp destination, pickup windows, supplier hours, ERD, cutoff, appointment and authorized contact context, without supplier buy price, buyer sell price, margin or unnecessary buyer identity. Existing domestic three-PDF dispatch remains unchanged for domestic movements.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Material amendments protect pending commitments and mail
rules.owner: Logistics/Linda transition and Odoo Mail, Export provides booking version
rules.normative_text: A changed booking, ERD, cutoff, terminal, actual equipment request or material delivery condition SHALL identify the exact affected Logistics movement and pending release/dispatch work orders, queue items and carrier commitments. The authorized Logistics/Linda owner SHALL invalidate or reassess only affected pending artifacts, retain prior sent evidence, and request new rate, schedule or acknowledgment if required. No automatic rebooking, PO reissuance or repeat send is authorized; unknown send outcome remains unknown.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: ERD and cutoff are terminal constraints, not supplier pickup dates
rules.owner: Export time values; Logistics pickup feasibility/appointments
rules.normative_text: For each specific load, Logistics SHALL plan a feasible supplier pickup and loaded gate-in from the current ERD, cutoff, terminal/ramp acceptance hours, appointments, loading duration, route transit, chassis/road constraints, buffer and authorized staging where used. ERD/cutoff SHALL NOT be converted directly into pickup appointments; inability to meet the window is a visible exception, not an invented ETA.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Equipment-aware freight context and explicit commitments
rules.owner: Logistics freight context/booking owner
rules.normative_text: The equipment type, count, container/chassis constraints and requested movement intent SHALL be available to Logistics carrier/rate eligibility at the proper source. Freight reuse or rate confirmation SHALL not treat `equipment_class=None` as proof that a 40HC and a 20STD are equivalent. Binding to PO/owned material with no sale shall preserve company identity and approved authority independently of `sale_order_id`.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Terminal and voyage milestones have distinct evidence
rules.owner: Logistics delivery tracking + native Documents proof; Export display
rules.normative_text: Pickup, arrival at terminal, accepted gate-in/rail receipt, booking compliance, vessel load/sail, destination discharge, actual customer delivery and legal title/risk milestones SHALL remain distinct facts. Carrier-issued originals, terminal receipts and actor verification govern proof; no status is inferred solely from planned cutoff, a driver photo, a shipping booking or a scanned package.

rules.chapter_title: Logistics/Linda handoff, schedule constraints and audience-safe packet issuance
rules.title: Movement authorization not tied to buyer visibility
rules.owner: Logistics/Linda audience and buyer-optional movement policy
rules.normative_text: Carrier dispatch SHALL be authorized against exact company, physical load, approved purchase/stock and/or commercial order source, destination, booking when applicable, carrier acceptance, and movement-specific guards. An actual buyer MAY be present but is not necessary for every valid supplier-backed movement; if present, buyer identity remains shielded unless needed and authorized. Existing sales-specific buyer requirements SHALL remain in their legitimate sales workflow.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Interpret the whole business correspondence package
rules.owner: Native Mail/Documents intake; AI extraction
rules.normative_text: Ingest the original email thread, individual messages, attachments, sender/recipient roles, time and quoted/forwarded context as separate attributed evidence without conflating message authors or treating quoted history as the latest instruction. Extract typed candidates from email body, PDF, XLSX and available source-linked photo evidence where accessible, with provenance for each value.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Recognize document and message function, not just keywords
rules.owner: Native Documents classification; plasticos_documents verification
rules.normative_text: Classify supplier PO, supplier readiness response, ocean booking original, booking summary, amendment/roll notice, cancellation, shipping/loading statement, scale ticket, load spreadsheet, gate receipt and externally hosted picture link as distinct evidence types. Do not label an operator-generated booking summary as a carrier-issued original or assume a link equals received pictures.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Resolve booking-versus-PO-versus-physical load identities
rules.owner: plasticos_documents exact association; Export booking context
rules.normative_text: The matcher SHALL distinguish commercial PO 64014 from ocean booking 6509024800, link one PO to multiple separately executed bookings and one booking to its nominated count of containers, and link the actual physical container using corroborated container ID, ticket, seal and load index. It must not assume a single booking, PO, load, container, or supplier email are the same entity; ambiguous parent/child links require review.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Extract original booking attributes and missing-field truth
rules.owner: Native AI extraction; Export target schema
rules.normative_text: From a source booking confirmation, extract exact booking string, steamship line, vessel, voyage, equipment class/count, ERD, cargo cutoff with supplied time precision, empty pickup site, loaded return site, receipt/port evidence, freight or material weight restrictions and other fields explicitly supplied. For POL and POD, keep unknown unless an authoritative source explicitly identifies the maritime ports; do not silently substitute local terminal or place of receipt.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Capture roll reasons, classifications, capacity and continuity
rules.owner: Export booking history and supplier/carrier evidence
rules.normative_text: A notice of a rolled or revised booking SHALL retain source attribution, stated reason (distinct from inferred possibilities: supplier not ready, impossible freight, steamship-line cancellation, schedule/equipment change, unknown), affected booking/units, previous and candidate equipment quantities, vessel/voyage, cargo/document/VGM cutoff, terminal-specific ERD, ETD/ETA and relevant time zones. Where the booking number persists, treat multiple original files as version candidates and preserve each exact original and evidence timestamp. A later PDF, filename suffix or forwarded message does not independently prove the official chronology or replace another terminal's ERD. Distinguish same-booking revision, supplemental capacity, replacement booking and unresolved contradiction before emitting approved current fields to Logistics or externally issued documents.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Maintain field-level current value, version, and approval
rules.owner: Export booking context; Documents verification
rules.normative_text: Each material field SHALL retain original raw value, parsed normalized value, source file/message locator, event time, supplier/carrier identity, assertion type, review status, effective time and superseded predecessor. A revised PDF using the same filename is distinct if content differs. An AI candidate becomes current only via an authorized deterministic policy: safe unambiguous initial fields may auto-apply when verified by controls, while conflicts, late changes and material dispatch-impacting values require review.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Use PO-level terms as constraints without copying financial values
rules.owner: Native Purchase, Documents evidence; Export/Logistics read
rules.normative_text: Extract and link PO-level quantity, material grade, unit, agreed trade label, delivery responsibility, minimum weight, conditional loading requirements, pictures, prohibited contamination and tare instructions as source-backed constraints. These remain authoritative native PO/contract business facts; Export displays applicability per shipping unit and may detect conflicts but SHALL NOT rewrite PO rate, quantity, pricing, AP/AR or transaction terms.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Cross-check physical documents, not guessed shipping completion
rules.owner: plasticos_documents evidence; native Stock/Logistics movement owners
rules.normative_text: Reconcile shipper completion email, loading spreadsheet and signed scale ticket on exact PO, booking, load index, date, container, seal, pieces, gross/tare/net and document identities. Physical weights and counts are evidence candidates, not necessarily invoice weight or legal verified gross mass. If reported identifiers/quantities conflict, preserve all versions, produce an exception and forbid unauthorized state advancement.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Track externally hosted photos and document completeness honestly
rules.owner: Native Documents original/linked assets; plasticos_documents requirement verdict
rules.normative_text: Capture applicable loading-picture checklist from PO/booking, identify original pictures and external-link references, and show available, missing, inaccessible and verified status separately. Requirements may differ by PO and booking revision; no blanket global photo checklist, storage clone or fabricated proof. Native Documents stores originals or the authorized reference and PlasticOS Documents computes verification.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Guard shipment state changes and order balances
rules.owner: Native Purchase/Sale/Stock and Logistics/Transaction guarded commands
rules.normative_text: Extraction SHALL produce typed event proposals; only the owning business command may advance supplier ready, loaded, pickup, gate accepted, sailed, inventory receipt/delivery or commercial state after all movement-specific checks and idempotency. One approved 40200-lb physical shipment does not complete a 200000-lb/five-container supplier PO, other bookings, or a customer multi-load SO. No direct AI writes to transaction.state or load.state.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Propagate only a verified material change to the right consumers
rules.owner: Export publishes revisions; Logistics/Linda owns schedule/mail
rules.normative_text: When a verified current booking revision changes ERD, cutoff, vessel/voyage, terminal or requested equipment, Export SHALL publish the scoped booking-version delta. Logistics evaluates only impacted physical loads and pending commitments, holds/revalidates stale work orders and exact queued communications, while Linda retains sent and unknown send outcomes. Supplier PO and other sibling bookings remain intact; no automatic carrier booking/rebooking or sending outside authorized Logistics policies.

rules.chapter_title: Real-world booking correspondence, rolls and AI coordinator behavior
rules.title: Offer a coordinator-style exception and audit view
rules.owner: Export sourced view + native Activity; Documents and Logistics originals
rules.normative_text: The operator SHALL be able to see which email/PDF/XLSX supplied each field, what changed since the prior booking, who asserted it, whether source is carrier-issued or supplier-reported, confidence and verification status, affected load(s), time-window feasibility, outstanding shipping photos/documents, and the next permitted owner action. Do not create a second case-management system or hidden auto-acceptance.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: FindTEU Phase 2 tracking adapter
rules.owner: plasticos_export integration boundary; provider is external evidence producer
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 SHALL include a separately configurable FindTEU adapter for available ocean container tracking and ETA/terminal milestones, using its documented API and authorized account. It SHALL be optional for operation of the core ERP and Phase 1, and SHALL not book carriers, set rates, dispatch drayage, perform stock movements or create a competing shipment registry.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Exact container identity and optional booking-number tracking
rules.owner: plasticos_export typed mapping; native Odoo shipping identity remains canonical
rules.normative_text: The FindTEU adapter SHALL bind a company-scoped provider observation to the exact known container and applicable ocean booking, with carrier/SCAC when known, including bookings with many containers. Booking-level tracking SHALL never assign a provider event to every container merely because they share an ocean reservation. Unknown, reused or conflicting identifiers require review.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Carrier observation is not commercial or stock authority
rules.owner: plasticos_export evidence projection with Logistics/Stock/Docs retained
rules.normative_text: FindTEU events SHALL preserve observed-at, effective event time, provider, raw payload reference, carrier, location, actual-vs-estimated designation, and normalized milestone; source timestamps and provider certainty shall remain visible. ETA, ETD, gate-in, vessel-loaded, discharge and provider completed flags SHALL NOT by themselves close a sale, prove title change, post invoices, verify documents or bypass guarded Logistics/Stock transitions.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Rolls, replay, reversals and provider discrepancies
rules.owner: plasticos_export booking reconciliation; Logistics authorizes affected actions
rules.normative_text: FindTEU ingestion SHALL be replay-safe and idempotent, preserve previous observations, distinguish later ETA estimates from actual voyage or terminal changes, and flag contradictions with the current verified booking/terminal documentary source. A roll or cancellation SHALL require attributable authoritative booking evidence and affected-container review. Provider errors, stale updates and absent coverage SHALL appear as unknown/exception, not silently overwrite current booking terms.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: FindTEU tenancy, credentials, outages and coverage gate
rules.owner: platform integration/security owner; Export is a consumer
rules.normative_text: FindTEU integration SHALL use tenant-isolated authorization and protected API keys, authenticated webhook ingress using a validated provider-supported verification design, quotas, bounded retries and error classification; protect commercial identity in outbound requests. It SHALL be feature-gated until provider contractual access, supported-carrier coverage, webhook security and a real-booking read-only proof pass. It SHALL not fabricate tracking status when provider data is missing.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: AESDirect Phase 2 EEI filing support, not autonomous filing
rules.owner: authorized USPPI/agent/filer and applicable regulator; Export filing context only
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 SHALL support ACE AESDirect EEI preparation, an applicability/exemption decision, the legally responsible USPPI or authorized agent, and status/evidence visibility. It SHALL NOT infer a mandatory EEI from an Incoterm or international booking alone, claim a regulatory determination absent the required facts, file EEI without an authorized filer, or require an AES account for Phase 1 or shipments outside applicable requirements.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Validate and assemble filing data from existing business sources
rules.owner: native Odoo Sale/Purchase/Stock and authorized compliance reviewer; Export orchestration
rules.normative_text: The AESDirect filing preparation view SHALL source reportable commodity classification, destination, value, quantities, UOM, dates, parties, port, transport and shipment identifiers from their correct native owner and explicit reviewed inputs. Missing or uncertain EEI elements SHALL remain incomplete and be surfaced before handoff; AI extraction may propose facts but must not silently supply legal classification, reporting party, value, license or exemption determinations.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Official AESDirect portal, WebLink or supported bulk handoff
rules.owner: authorized filer; connector only prepares supported handoff
rules.normative_text: Initial Phase 2 integration SHALL provide an authorized-user filing handoff to ACE AESDirect with a reviewable data packet and, where tested and approved, its documented WebLink Submission API for prepopulating the portal or a validated AESTIR/X12 bulk-upload file. AES WebLink still requires the filer to sign in, complete missing elements and submit in the official system. This requirement does NOT authorize an uncertified direct AES transmission service or unattended government filing.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Official response, ITN or exemption evidence and errors
rules.owner: authorized filing authority + native Documents/PlasticOS verification
rules.normative_text: Only the official AES acceptance response and Internal Transaction Number (ITN), or applicable legally supported exemption evidence, SHALL support the corresponding filing outcome. Record filer, authoritative source, acceptance/rejection status, timestamp, exact shipment/export record and document original; reject ambiguous source matches and preserve rejected messages. Export SHALL display the verified projection and Logistics/other owners may consume it only according to their own lawful guarded workflow.

rules.chapter_title: Phase 2 provider integrations (FindTEU + ACE AESDirect)
rules.title: Amendments, cancellations, access control and certification boundary
rules.owner: authorized filer and platform security; Export only coordinates evidence
rules.normative_text: Phase 2 filing corrections, voids, late amendments, role authorization and disclosures SHALL follow applicable official filing rules through the authorized filer. Keep the original filing decision, revised data, ITN/rejection evidence and source-linked audit trail. Optional certified direct transmission is DEFERRED as a separate future authorization/certification decision, not included in this Phase 2 scope. Failure or missing permissions SHALL fail closed without changing native order/invoice or stock state.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Primary booking identity and existing six critical fields
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The Export form SHALL present an authoritative booking identity with booking number, shipping line, POL, POD, cargo cutoff, ERD, plus source document, revision, effective date and exact company scope. No field SHALL be duplicated when its canonical Odoo equivalent already exists.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Additional independent deadline types and timezone
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Booking form SHALL distinguish cargo/gate cutoff, documentation cutoff, VGM cutoff, and earliest loaded return; each holds date, time, time zone where known, source/version, and confirmed-versus-proposed status. Missing values remain unset rather than borrowed from another deadline.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Carrier, forwarder, vessel, voyage and transport milestones
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL display shipping line, forwarder/booking agent where applicable, vessel, voyage, estimated/actual ETD and ETA with exact source. Recurring updates SHALL preserve old revisions. Physical arrival or gate-in belongs to Logistics/Stock evidence and is never inferred solely from ETA.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Port versus receipt, delivery and terminal locations
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL distinguish POL, POD, place of receipt, final place of delivery, empty container pickup facility, loaded container return terminal and rail ramp. Export publishes applicable booking constraints; Logistics owns actual pickup, terminal appointments and execution.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Equipment quantity and multiple independent container identities
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL show requested equipment type and quantity at booking level and actual container number, seal, physical load, supplier PO, transaction and observed weights at container level. One ocean booking may include multiple supplier POs, multiple trade transactions and containers; allocation is exact and reversible.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Contract references and cargo constraints
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The booking form SHALL expose reference numbers (order, house/master bill where supported), booking date, booking contact, cargo description, classification code when evidenced, and contractual minimum/maximum cargo weights; use native product/partner/quantity models as canonical owners. Weight constraints never authoritatively rewrite actual or invoiced weight.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Optional commercial group and current booking status
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Booking date, contact, optional group, forwarder, agreement/reference and booking confirmation status SHALL be displayed when source-backed. Status must distinguish requested, confirmed, revised, rolled, cancelled, expired and partially fulfilled where those semantics are evidenced; do not infer confirmation from UI display or email timestamp.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: AI extraction fills only exact authoritative targets
rules.owner: plasticos_documents + native Odoo AI/Document owners; Export consumes validated candidates
rules.normative_text: Native Odoo 19 AI Documents may extract booking-form fields from emails, PDFs, and spreadsheets with page/message/field provenance. Existing `plasticos_documents` resolves exact booking, company, PO, transaction, container and revision before an authorized export action writes permitted fields. Ambiguous or material conflicts require review; AI must not set physical, commercial or financial states directly.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Native-first ergonomic booking form and tabs
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Booking presentation SHALL use Odoo form, smart buttons/related records and standard tabbed views for Shipments, Order Allocation, Instructions, Budget Expenses and Documentation only where there is an existing authoritative source; tabs must not host duplicate ledger, document, logistics or accounting data.

rules.chapter_title: Booking form, extended fields and documentary reconciliation
rules.title: Carrier document and operator-generated booking distinction
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Export SHALL distinguish a carrier/forwarder original booking confirmation from an export-generated booking report/supplier summary. Files belong to native Documents, verification to PlasticOS Documents and communications to Linda; the form may expose print/send actions only through these owners.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Native Odoo reporting foundation only
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The Export reporting component SHALL be built from Odoo 19 native list, search, favorite, group-by, pivot/graph, spreadsheet/export and QWeb report capabilities. Add only needed read-only joins/projections and views. No competing report engine, independent analytics store or user-specific report code copies.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Container-grain master report
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The canonical detailed container report SHALL yield one row per physical container/journey allocation, sourced from exact native records: container, seal, booking, supplier PO, buyer SO where assigned, original physical load, commodity, weight, carrier, vessel, voyage, origin/destination and evidence status. Multi-party bookings and missing buyers are supported without dummy identities.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Booking-grain summary with drill-down
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The booking report SHALL show carrier, POL/POD, latest sourced deadlines and their time zones, equipment planned/assigned, vessel/voyage, ETD/ETA, number and summed weight of distinct containers, document completeness and exceptions. Booking summary and per-container report SHALL be separate grains with click-through to exact individual orders/loads.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Search, filters and stable saved views
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Provide search by Booking No., Container No., Seal, PO, SO, Source Worksheet/Trade identity, invoice/BOL where authorized, and filters for POL, POD, carrier, vessel, supplier, customer, grade, departments, ownership, status, deadlines and missing documents. Support saved Favorites and sharable role-scoped views via native Odoo.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Convenient interactive list and export
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The list SHALL support default useful columns, optional column visibility, sort, group, page, drill-through and export of user-selected filtered rows to native XLSX/CSV according to permissions. No forced PDF for operational spreadsheets; print-ready layout SHALL use QWeb when needed.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Report column provenance and business-owner mapping
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The report schema SHALL explicitly map each required source column to an authoritative existing Odoo or PlasticOS owner. Missing sources SHALL appear as NOT_IMPLEMENTED/UNVERIFIED rather than fabricate a value; legacy labels are mapping hints, not permission for new duplicate fields.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Date semantics, time zones and cutoff risk
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Reporting SHALL preserve document cutoff, VGM cutoff, gate cutoff, ERD, actual supplier shipping date, estimated/actual sailing and arrival separately, including time zone and source/revision. Show missed or approaching deadlines from current authoritative facts without rescheduling loads directly.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Weight, equipment tare, VGM and units
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The detailed report SHALL distinguish cargo net weight, supplier or scale weight provenance, number of units, equipment tare, and compliant VGM when actually verified; display lb and metric ton using a single explicit conversion policy. Preserve null and unknown rather than printing zero as fact. Do not make a raw gross/tare formula into certified VGM.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Native pivots and useful operating metrics
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Provide native Odoo pivot/graph/dashboard measures for count of distinct physical containers, cargo weight by supplier/buyer/grade/month/port/steamship line, booking capacity-versus-allocated, unfulfilled PO/SO quantities, exceptions and document completeness. Financial measures must come from approved native accounting/transaction economics with stated recognition/actual-cost policy.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Audience-safe QWeb and source-linked revisions
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: Reports SHALL support separate print-ready booking summary, shipment/packing list when supported by verified physical facts, and operational exceptions/QWeb PDFs. Report generation records the source revision/as-of time; actual external sending remains Linda and original retention remains Documents. Supplier/trucker/buyer/internal audiences SHALL have distinct permitted fields.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Source workbook as conformance fixture, not production authority
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: The attached booking report.xlsx (372 data rows, 43 column headings) SHALL serve as a private comparison fixture to design semantics and test exports. Historical legacy report values do not become a new system of record; migrated values require validated exact identity and allowed ownership.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Access control and reproducible report scope
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: All reporting respects native company/tenant access, row rules, commercial confidentiality and customer/supplier/carrier audiences. Saved filters, download scope, calculated quantities, source timestamp and report user are reproducible. Use authorized Odoo actions; no raw unrestricted SQL reporting endpoint.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Phase 2 provider evidence is additive
rules.owner: plasticos_export; native Odoo owns shared commercial and logistics facts
rules.normative_text: In Phase 2, optional FindTEU observations and AESDirect filing evidence may appear as separately labeled status columns and filters. Missing integration, a late provider update or unverified filing response shall never suppress a core report or rewrite native shipment/filing authority.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Booking capacity is equipment-specific and source-confirmed
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: The booking availability workbench SHALL show, per current company-scoped carrier reservation AND equipment type, requested capacity, confirmed capacity, committed booking-slot allocations, executed/loaded containers, remaining assignable capacity and source validity. Confirmed capacity is not derived from a sales order or empty field. Only active source-confirmed capacity is eligible; cancelled, expired, proposed or rolled bookings are labelled separately. An operational hold, if genuinely authorized, is separately identified and reduces assignable capacity; a tentative candidate does not. A shipped container does not reopen a slot without explicit carrier evidence.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: One booking slot can serve multiple correctly attributed cargo lines
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: Booking-space allocation SHALL identify an exact distinct equipment slot or legitimate planned shipment assignment, link it to eligible actual load/transaction or approved native order lines as applicable, and preserve zero or more related supplier PO and customer SO lines without multiplying the slot. The physical ISO container number may be unknown at planning time; later evidence binds the real number to the same slot. Export owns booking-slot assignment only, never commercial ordered/reserved/delivered quantity or actual stock movement. No fictitious load is created for a tentative allocation.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Explicit allocation commands respect capacity and revision
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: Assign, release, substitute, split or reallocate booking space SHALL be an authorized explicit booking operation with company, equipment, responsible source, target slot or movement, revision and audit trail. Concurrent assignments must not overcommit capacity. If a booking revision lowers quantity below committed slots or changes equipment, show the impacted allocations and block unsafe new commitment; never silently delete an actual container, undo physical delivery, rebook trucks, reissue communications or pretend a released slot exists without evidence.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Native-first Bookings control center with actionable drilldowns
rules.owner: plasticos_export
rules.normative_text: The Export Overview SHALL be the native Odoo landing dashboard and summary/navigation surface for **all six Phase 1 core reports** named in BRS-EXP-14-R021: Booking Space Availability; Booking Allocation / Container Manifest; Open PO / SO Fulfillment; Container Shipment Register; Cutoff & Booking Exceptions; and Missing Export Documents. It SHALL present at least one genuinely informative source-owned, grain-correct current metric, exception or compact visualization per report, with a clearly identifiable direct link to that exact report. Each card/chart/table element SHALL drill to the contributing filtered records under the user’s company/role access, with per-metric source and as-of information and a path from report to exact booking, slot, container, commercial order or document evidence. Summary is not a replacement for the six reports. Prefer native Odoo Spreadsheet Dashboard, list/pivot/graph and native actions, with a searchable-list fallback if the Dashboard app is unavailable. No separate reporting engine or new writer.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Available bookings and unbooked demand remain distinct
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: Provide saved native lists for Available Bookings, Fully Allocated, Awaiting Carrier Confirmation, Rolled/Cancelled, Unallocated Eligible Cargo, Ready without Booking, Buyer Unassigned, and Booking with Multiple Suppliers. Availability is carrier capacity; unallocated demand is a distinct eligible physical/commercial need. Bookings with no current PO/load remain visible. Buyer-unassigned cargo must remain visible rather than being rejected or silently assigned to an arbitrary SO.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Deadline and allocation risk view without second dispatch authority
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: Provide a booking-focused calendar and saved views for ERD, cargo cutoff, documentation cutoff, VGM cutoff, ETD/ETA, impending release and amendments, preserving source revision/time zone. Show whether allocations and supplier readiness permit a feasible move based on Logistics owner facts. Export SHALL NOT reschedule, select carriers, send messages, or declare gate-in; user actions route to the authoritative Logistics/Linda commands or native Activities.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Per-booking document readiness is read-only and attributable
rules.owner: plasticos_export (projection; source owners unchanged)
rules.normative_text: The booking and container workspaces SHALL display only operation-specific document requirements, verified/current evidence, missing items, superseded source revisions, supplier loading photos and actual proof of terminal acceptance from the Documents/Logistics authorities. A source booking notice and generated booking summary must be visibly distinguished. Native Activities present internal exceptions; Linda owns any external chase or outbound send.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Minimal report suite with explicit grain and replayable filters
rules.owner: plasticos_export
rules.normative_text: The six required Phase 1 reports SHALL be (1) Booking Space Availability, (2) Booking Allocation / Container Manifest, (3) Open Supplier PO / Customer SO Fulfillment, (4) Container Shipment Register, (5) Cutoff & Booking Exceptions, and (6) Missing Export Documents. Each SHALL have a stable Odoo list/pivot/graph/spreadsheet route and grain-correct report scope so the Overview can summarize and open the exact contributing rows. Export Economics is an optional separate authorized report when Accounting provides accepted figures; it is not the sixth mandatory report. QWeb is for audience-safe printable booking/packing/exception snapshots. Counts use booking-slot, container-journey, order-line, amendment or evidence-obligation grains as appropriate, with source-authenticated units, weights, company permissions, revision and as-of. No duplicate report ledger, second scheduler or mailer.

rules.chapter_title: Native Odoo reporting and operational intelligence views
rules.title: Six-report dashboard coverage and exact filter-preserving navigation
rules.owner: plasticos_export
rules.normative_text: Each of the six Phase 1 dashboard sections SHALL bind to the same authoritative, appropriately filtered source population as its linked report. The required dashboard-to-report contract is: availability -> current confirmed/allocated/free slots by equipment; allocations -> committed slots and overallocations; fulfillment -> outstanding PO/SO line quantity and ready-but-unbooked demand with units; shipment register -> distinct loaded/in-transit/terminal-accepted containers; deadline exceptions -> imminent cutoffs, rolls and stale booking revisions; missing documents -> exact overdue or missing current verified evidence obligations by owner. Clicking a tile/measure SHALL open its matching report with compatible company, operator rights, period, equipment, booking, state, source-revision and exception filters; report rows SHALL then open the correctly authorized underlying business record/evidence. If native Odoo action/filter propagation cannot preserve a chosen cross-source scope, provide the minimum authorized action binding, never a custom dashboard engine. Label when-as-of, stale/pending/unknown, report currentness and privilege-limited omissions. Empty or inaccessible populations SHALL not masquerade as an accepted zero.
